question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sink**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**sink**" means to go down below the surface of a liquid or soft substance. (किसी तरल या मुलायम पदार्थ की सतह से नीचे जाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The boat started to sink after hitting a rock in the water.*
 
 
 
• *​*In this context, the word "sink" is used metaphorically to convey the idea that when we die, our physical bodies descend or transition into the sky. 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swing **means to move back and forth or from side to side while hanging from something or being suspended. (किसी चीज से लटकते या लटकते समय आगे-पीछे या अगल-बगल से हिलना)
 
• **Climb **means to go up or ascend, often with effort or difficulty. (अक्सर प्रयास या कठिनाई के साथ ऊपर जाना या चढ़ना)
 
• **Draw **can have multiple meanings, including making a picture or diagram by making lines and marks on paper or pulling something or someone in a particular direction. (कागज पर रेखाएँ और निशान बनाकर चित्र या आरेख बनाना या किसी वस्तु या व्यक्ति को किसी विशेष दिशा में खींचना)
